subject.title: fix(google-vertex): add Google Vertex AI onboarding wizard, fix ADC auth, add provider docs

question: Should this PR establish the canonical Google Vertex ADC onboarding/auth contract, including the relaxed auth gate, marker profile, default global location, and new env-vars-with-marker manifest evidence type?
rationale: The patch appears technically coherent and proven, but it changes provider auth/setup semantics and overlaps active Vertex work; automation cannot choose the permanent compatibility contract for existing and future Google Vertex users.

options.title: Accept this PR's contract
options.body: Proceed with this PR after owner review, treating the relaxed ADC gate and marker-based onboarding as the canonical Google Vertex setup path.

options.title: Narrow the landing scope
options.body: Ask for a smaller patch that lands only the maintainer-approved ADC onboarding pieces while deferring catalog/model/default policy to the active Vertex cluster.

options.title: Use another canonical PR
options.body: Pause this PR if maintainers prefer the broader open Google Vertex provider PR to own the final provider/auth direction.

recommendation.title: Accept this PR's contract
recommendation.body: Proceed with this PR after owner review, treating the relaxed ADC gate and marker-based onboarding as the canonical Google Vertex setup path.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent onboarding/provider-catalog work and broad AI runtime ownership make this the strongest available owner signal for the cross-surface setup contract decision.
